# typeassert: matchCond returns nil for non-EQL/NEQ conditions
typeassert {
	var x I
	x.M() == 1 -> x.(m1)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type I interface{ M() int }
type m1 int

func (m1) M() int { return 1 }

func f(x I) {
	// Unrelated if with > operator - matchCond returns nil
	if x.M() > 0 {
		println("positive")
	}
	// Matching if with == operator
	if x.M() == 1 {
		_ = x
	}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
 	}
 	// Matching if with == operator
 	if x.M() == 1 {
+		x := x.(m1)
 		_ = x
 	}
 }
